correctness.rationale: For every integer N in 2..65536 and grid j/N, exact stochastic rounding of 4j(N-j)/N has support on integer indices floor and ceil with strictly positive weights whenever distinct. The supplied integer C++ verifier builds all directed edges for each N, reverse-BFS from 0 and checks that the only vertices not reaching 0 are empty when 4 does not divide N or precisely j=N/4,3N/4 when 4 divides N. Independently reconstructed and executed all four disjoint exhaustive blocks, covering every one of 65,535 denominators and 2,147,581,950 states without discrepancies. The extra two vertices are a feeder 1/4 to absorbing 3/4; all others reach 0, eliminating any other closed class. In any finite chain transient states absorb almost surely, and invariant probabilities are convex combinations of 0/3/4 point masses. Separately nearest-support transport from arcsine density at split 3/8 gives exact Wasserstein minimum about .15568790319968789436 and W1(delta0,rho)=1/2. This is a complete FINITE classification only through N=65536, not an all-N proof.
